entities.name: Erik Černák
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erik Černák is a Slovak professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Tampa Bay Lightning of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Los Angeles Kings in the second round, 43rd overall, in the 2015 NHL entry draft. Černák won back-to-back Stanley Cup championships with the Lightning in 2020 and 2021.
